sources.title: Stable Diffusion V1 5 - AI Models
sources.snippet: Stable Diffusion V1 5 Stable Diffusion is an AI model that can generate photo-realistic images from text inputs. It uses a latent text-to-image diffusion process to create these images, which can be used for a variety of applications such as generating artwork, creating visuals for marketing materials, and more.
